Enabled.title: Enable OTP sign-in
Enabled.description: Allow customers to sign in to the storefront with a one-time code emailed to them, instead of a password.

EmailRequestCooldownSeconds.title: Email cooldown, seconds
EmailRequestCooldownSeconds.description: Minimum time between two code requests for the same email. Applies globally, to every store. Requires an app restart to take effect.

IpRequestLimit.title: Request limit per IP
IpRequestLimit.description: Maximum number of code requests allowed from one IP address within the request window below. Applies globally, to every store. Requires an app restart to take effect.

IpRequestWindowSeconds.title: Request window per IP, seconds
IpRequestWindowSeconds.description: The rolling time window the request limit per IP is measured over. Applies globally, to every store. Requires an app restart to take effect.
